answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can influence a shared task, then slash that stake when independent reviewers confirm fabricated work. A plume of fresh identities gains no weight merely by appearing: influence accrues only through verified contributions, while a lantern-style audit samples claims and publishes a signal when evidence fails. The attacker must lock real capital in every identity and risks losing it, making a cheap Sybil swarm costly rather than persuasive.
